node_definition.done_when: Done when a new test file shows, using the repository's shared test isolation: an investigate run carrying a brief and no plan, and a plan-review run, each with the manifest line above, pass the manifest check and promote with the no-commit form, and each run record names the base revision and no commit; the same with bare none ; a run stating none with a commit beyond its base is refused, naming that commit; and the composed prompt for each role states the line. Negative control: the manifest names which case fails at the base revision and quotes its refusal. If every case passes at the base revision, the node reports the commit that changed the behaviour since 2026-11-14 and changes no product source. The test files that import the manifest check or the promotion evidence check add no failure against the base revision, and ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths.
